title: mentha × verticillata var. origanifolia
intro: Mentha × verticillata var. origanifolia, commonly known as Spearmint, is a hybrid mint plant species that is a cross between Mentha spicata and Mentha × gracilis. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include aiding in digestion, reducing nausea, and relieving stress and anxiety. Spearmint's therapeutic actions include its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Mentha × verticillata var. origanifolia include menthone, menthyl acetate, and carvone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
